GROUP BY time($__interval), "host"::tag fill(previous)

SELECT mean("value")
FROM "memory_value"
WHERE ("type_instance" = 'used'
    OR "type_instance" = 'free'
    OR "type_instance" = 'buffered'
    OR "type_instance" = 'cached'
    OR "type_instance" = 'slab_recl'
    OR "type_instance" = 'slab_unrecl')
AND "host"::tag =~ /^Crypto-InfluxDB-[0-9]{2}$/
AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($interval), "type_instance"::tag, "host"::tag
fill(null)

SELECT mean("value") AS "used_percent"
FROM "memory_value"
WHERE "type_instance" = 'used'
AND "host"::tag =~ /^Crypto-InfluxDB-[0-9]{2}$/
AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($interval), "host"::tag, "type_instance"::tag
fill(null);

SELECT 100 * mean("value") 
    / (mean("value") 
        + mean("free") 
        + mean("buffered") 
        + mean("cached") 
        + mean("slab_recl") 
        + mean("slab_unrecl")) AS "memory_utilization"
FROM "memory_value"
WHERE ("type_instance" = 'used' 
    OR "type_instance" = 'free' 
    OR "type_instance" = 'buffered' 
    OR "type_instance" = 'cached' 
    OR "type_instance" = 'slab_recl' 
    OR "type_instance" = 'slab_unrecl')
AND "host"::tag =~ /^Crypto-InfluxDB-[0-9]{2}$/
AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($interval), "host"::tag, "type_instance"::tag
fill(null);
